title: Where Do I Begin ( Love Story theme )
lyrics_plain:
Where do I begin
To tell the story
Of how great a love can be
The sweet love story
that is older than it seems
The simple truth about
the love he brings to me
Where do I start
Like the summer rain
That cools the pavement
With a patent leather shine
He came into my life
and made the living fine
And gave a meaning to
this empty world of mine
He fills my heart
He fills my heart
With very special things
With angel songs
With wild imaginings
He fills my soul
With so much love
And anywhere I go
I'm never lonely
With him along
Who could be lonely
I reach for his hand
It's always there
How long does it last
Could love be measured by the
hours in the day
I have no answers now
But this much I can say
I'm going to need him
'til the stars all run away
And he'll be there
